sentences.sentence: Doctor Mulholland tested Jennifer’s reflexes (= especially by hitting her knee with a special rubber hammer ) .
sentences.translation: 马尔霍兰医生检查了珍妮弗的反射反应。

sentences.sentence: If water had a negative index of refraction, then a straw placed in a glass would appear to bend back under itself.
sentences.translation: 如果水具有负折射率，那么放在玻璃杯中的吸管似乎可能弯曲到自身下方。

sentences.sentence: With all that reflection and refraction, modernism creates the illusion that there is an illusion when in fact it is a straightforward statement of money and power.
sentences.translation: 通过反射和折射，现代主义创造了一个幻觉存在的假象，而实际上它是对金钱和权力不加掩饰的声明。

sentences.sentence: Rapidly changing refraction due to turbulence along the line of sight affects different colors of light by different amounts and generally produces a twinkling effect for stars.
sentences.translation: 由于湍流而快速变化的折射在视线中会影响到光的不同颜色，这种影响也各不相同，一般会给恒星产生一种闪烁的效果。

sentences.sentence: Mrs. Hardie refrained from making any comment.
sentences.translation: 哈迪太太忍住了没做任何评论。

sentences.sentence: The plane was refuelled in Dubai.
sentences.translation: 飞机在迪拜加过油。

sentences.translation: 难民正涌过边境。

sentences.translation: 我把收音机送回去，他们给我退了款。

sentences.sentence: He prepared a complete refutation of the Republicans' most serious charges.
sentences.translation: 他准备全面反驳共和党人对他最严重的指控。

sentences.sentence: It was the kind of rumour that it is impossible to refute.
sentences.translation: 这是那种不可能推翻的谣言。

sentences.sentence: Small nodules form as the liver cells regenerate.
sentences.translation: 肝细胞再生时会形成一些小结节。

phrases.translation: [英]（办理世俗结婚手续或出生、死亡等登记的）户籍登记处

控制寄存器；控制暂存器
n. 现金收支票据纸；注册文件；划线记录纸

sentences.sentence: The tanker is registered in Rotterdam.
sentences.translation: 这艘油轮是在鹿特丹登记的。

sentences.sentence: Many considered the changes to the welfare laws a regressive step.
sentences.translation: 许多人认为福利法的变革是一种退步。

sentences.sentence: For several minutes confusion reigned .
sentences.translation: 有好几分钟场面大乱。

sentences.sentence: Silence reigned while we waited for news.
sentences.translation: 我们在等待消息的时候鸦雀无声。

sentences.sentence: I'll be happy to reimburse you for any expenses you've had.
sentences.translation: 我很乐意报销你的所有花费。

sentences.sentence: The film reinforces the idea that women should be pretty and dumb.
sentences.translation: 这部影片强化了这个观点——女人要漂亮，而且要笨一些。

sentences.sentence: The central bank said interest rates would remain on hold at 0 to 0.25 per cent for an “extended period” and it would continue to reinvest in its securities portfolio.
sentences.translation: 美联储表示，利率将在“相当长一段时间”内继续维持在零到0.25%的水平，而且它将继续将投资所得再投资于它的证券组合。

sentences.sentence: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
sentences.translation: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

sentences.sentence: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
sentences.translation: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

sentences.sentence: His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
sentences.translation: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 117 单元

reflective
音标：英 /rɪ'flektɪv/  美 /rɪ'flɛktɪv/
adj. 反射的；反映的；沉思的
短语：reflective teaching — 反映性教学
短语：reflective mirror — 反光镜
短语：reflective glass — 反光玻璃；反射玻璃
短语：reflective tape — 反光带
例句：Stick reflective tape on your school bag.
给你的书包贴上反光带。

reflex
音标：英 /'riːfleks/  美 /'riflɛks/
n. 反射；反映；映像；回复；习惯性思维
adj. 反射的；反省的；反作用的；优角的
短语：conditioned reflex — 条件反射
短语：light reflex — 光反射，对光反射
短语：reflex arc — [医]反射弧
短语：baroreceptor reflex — 压力感受性反射，压力感受拼射
短语：reflex reflector — 反射器，回复反射器
短语：blink reflex — [医]瞬目反射
短语：reflex action — 反射动作；反射作用
短语：gag reflex — 咽反射；呕反射
例句：Doctor Mulholland tested Jennifer’s reflexes (= especially by hitting her knee with a special rubber hammer ) .
马尔霍兰医生检查了珍妮弗的反射反应。

refraction
音标：英 /rɪ'frækʃ(ə)n/  美 /rɪ'frækʃən/
n. 折射；折光
短语：refraction index — 折射指数，折光指数
短语：index of refraction — [物]折射率
短语：negative refraction — 负折射
短语：double refraction — 双折射
短语：refraction coefficient — 折射系数
短语：seismic refraction — 震波折射
例句：If water had a negative index of refraction, then a straw placed in a glass would appear to bend back under itself.
如果水具有负折射率，那么放在玻璃杯中的吸管似乎可能弯曲到自身下方。
例句：With all that reflection and refraction, modernism creates the illusion that there is an illusion when in fact it is a straightforward statement of money and power.
通过反射和折射，现代主义创造了一个幻觉存在的假象，而实际上它是对金钱和权力不加掩饰的声明。
例句：Rapidly changing refraction due to turbulence along the line of sight affects different colors of light by different amounts and generally produces a twinkling effect for stars.
由于湍流而快速变化的折射在视线中会影响到光的不同颜色，这种影响也各不相同，一般会给恒星产生一种闪烁的效果。

refrain
音标：英 /rɪ'freɪn/  美 /rɪ'fren/
v. 节制，克制；避免；制止
n. 叠句，副歌；重复
短语：refrain from — 克制；抑制；忍住
例句：Mrs. Hardie refrained from making any comment.
哈迪太太忍住了没做任何评论。

refuel
音标：英 /riː'fjʊəl/  美 /ri'fjʊəl/
v. 补给燃料
例句：The plane was refuelled in Dubai.
飞机在迪拜加过油。

refugee
音标：英 /refjʊ'dʒiː/  美 /'rɛfjʊdʒi/
n. 难民，避难者；流亡者，逃亡者
短语：refugee camp — 难民营；难民收容所
例句：Refugees were streaming across the border.
难民正涌过边境。
例句：{"COLLOINEXA":["refugee camps"]}
难民营

refund
音标：英 /ˈriːfʌnd/  美 /ˈrifʌnd/
v. 退还；偿还，归还
n. 退款；偿还，偿还额
短语：tax refund — 退税；退税单
例句：I took the radio back, and they refunded my money .
我把收音机送回去，他们给我退了款。

refutation
音标：英 /,refjuː'teɪʃən/  美 /,rɛfjʊ'teʃən/
n. 反驳；驳斥；辩驳
例句：He prepared a complete refutation of the Republicans' most serious charges.
他准备全面反驳共和党人对他最严重的指控。

refute
音标：英 /rɪ'fjuːt/  美 /ri'fjʊt/
v. 反驳，驳斥；驳倒
例句：It was the kind of rumour that it is impossible to refute.
这是那种不可能推翻的谣言。

regenerate
音标：英 /rɪ'dʒenəreɪt/  美 /rɪ'dʒɛnəret/
v. 使再生；革新
adj. 再生的；革新的
例句：Small nodules form as the liver cells regenerate.
肝细胞再生时会形成一些小结节。

regime
音标：英 /reɪ'ʒiːm/  美 /re'ʒim/
n. 政权，政体；社会制度；管理体制
短语：flow regime — 流态；水流动态
短语：water regime — 水情；水文状况
短语：military regime — 军事政权
短语：hydrological regime — 水文状况，水分状况
短语：thermal regime — 热状况；热动态；热体制
短语：exchange-rate regime — 汇率机制
短语：currency regime — 汇率制度
例句：The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
该政权清除了大多数反对者。

regiment
音标：英 /'redʒɪm(ə)nt/  美 /'rɛdʒɪmənt/
v. 把…编成团；严格地管制
n. 团；大量
例句：the regimented routine of boarding school
寄宿学校严格的生活规律

regionalization
n. 区域化；分成地区；按地区安排

register
音标：英 /'redʒɪstə/  美 /'rɛdʒɪstɚ/
v. 登记；注册；记录；挂号邮寄；把…挂号；正式提出
n. 登记；注册；记录；寄存器；登记簿
短语：register for — 注册；选课
短语：register with — 向…登记
短语：cash register — 现金出纳机，收银机
短语：census register — 户籍登记簿
短语：register system — 寄存系统，记录系统
短语：household register — 户口簿
短语：shift register — [计]移位寄存器
短语：register now — 现在注册；立即注册
短语：register file — 寄存器文件；寄存蒲
短语：register office — [英]（办理世俗结婚手续或出生、死亡等登记的）户籍登记处
短语：federal register — 联邦公报；联邦登记簿
短语：register card — 登记卡；注册资料卡
短语：company register — 公司登记册；公司会议记录簿
短语：control register — 控制寄存器；控制暂存器
短语：register paper — n. 现金收支票据纸；注册文件；划线记录纸
短语：in register — 对得齐；配准
短语：lloyd's register — 英国劳埃德船级社
短语：hotel register — 住宿登记；旅客登记簿
短语：data register — 数据寄存器
短语：status register — 状态寄存器（等于status byte）
例句：The tanker is registered in Rotterdam.
这艘油轮是在鹿特丹登记的。

regressive
音标：英 /rɪ'gresɪv/  美 /rɪ'ɡrɛsɪv/
adj. 回归的；后退的；退化的
例句：Many considered the changes to the welfare laws a regressive step.
许多人认为福利法的变革是一种退步。

reign
音标：英 /reɪn/  美 /ren/
v. 统治；支配；盛行；君临
n. 统治；统治时期；支配
短语：reign over — 统治；盛行
短语：reign of terror — 恐怖统治
短语：reign supreme — ◎主宰；称雄
例句：For several minutes confusion reigned .
有好几分钟场面大乱。
例句：Silence reigned while we waited for news.
我们在等待消息的时候鸦雀无声。

reimburse
音标：英 /,riːɪm'bɜːs/  美 /,riɪm'bɝs/
v. 偿还；赔偿
例句：I'll be happy to reimburse you for any expenses you've had.
我很乐意报销你的所有花费。

reinforce
音标：英 /riːɪn'fɔːs/  美 /,riɪn'fɔrs/
v. 加强，加固；强化；补充
n. 加强；加固物；加固材料
短语：reinforce the management — 加强管理
例句：The film reinforces the idea that women should be pretty and dumb.
这部影片强化了这个观点——女人要漂亮，而且要笨一些。

reinvest
音标：美 /'riɪn'vɛst/
v. 再投资于；再授给
例句：The central bank said interest rates would remain on hold at 0 to 0.25 per cent for an “extended period” and it would continue to reinvest in its securities portfolio.
美联储表示，利率将在“相当长一段时间”内继续维持在零到0.25%的水平，而且它将继续将投资所得再投资于它的证券组合。

reject
音标：英 /rɪ'dʒekt/  美 /rɪ'dʒɛkt/
v. 拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃
n. 被弃之物或人；次品
短语：reject rate — 废品率；拒绝率
短语：reject ratio — 废品率；退件率
例句：Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。
例句：Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。
例句：His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
他的建议被彻底否决了。
